content_sections.heading: IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 446 Posts
content_sections.text: The Indian Air Force Base Repair Depot has announced 446 apprenticeship seats across 27 technical trades. Candidates must select a trade matching their recognized ITI qualification.

content_sections.text: The age limit is 17 to 35 years as on the apprenticeship course commencement date, 2 February 2027. Candidates must satisfy the age eligibility on the specified date and submit valid proof of date of birth.

content_sections.text: No application fee is prescribed for the advertised apprenticeship registration. Applications must be submitted through the official apprenticeship registration portal.

content_sections.heading: IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for ATP Batch-07 will be based on academic merit and the prescribed verification and medical fitness requirements. Online apprenticeship registration. Preparation of academic merit based on Class 10/Class 12 and ITI marks, as applicable. Additional weightage for eligible sportspersons and NCC certificate holders. Shortlisting of candidates. Issue of call letters. Verification of original educational and other supporting documents. Medical fitness examination. Final selection and commencement of apprenticeship training. Important: The notification does not prescribe a separate written competitive examination for this apprenticeship recruitment. Candidates are shortlisted through the prescribed academic and other merit criteria. The recruitment notice provides additional consideration for eligible candidates with sports achievements at the district, state or national level. Candidates possessing NCC B or C certificates may also receive the prescribed weightage during selection. Relevant certificates must be produced during document verification.

content_sections.heading: IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Medical Fitness Requirements
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the medical standards applicable to apprenticeship training. Candidates must meet the medical requirements prescribed under the applicable apprenticeship training standards.

Healthy Gums and Teeth, Minimum 14 Dental Points
Medically Fit and Free from Disqualifying Active or Latent Diseases and Disabilities under Applicable Standards

content_sections.heading: IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply through the official Apprenticeship India portal. Apply Online: www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in Registration Start Date: 11 November 2026. Candidates should use the official apprenticeship opportunities search to find the relevant establishment and technical trade.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Apprenticeship India portal . Complete candidate registration using a valid email address and mobile number. Log in to the apprenticeship portal. Complete the required personal and educational profile details. Keep Aadhaar and other identity information ready. Search for Base Repair Depot, Air Force, Chandigarh under Apprenticeship Opportunities. Select the relevant apprenticeship trade. Check the trade-wise eligibility and available seats. Enter Class 10, Class 12 (if applicable) and ITI marks accurately. Upload the required qualification certificates and other documents. Upload the prescribed recent colour passport photograph with the required name-slate details. Complete the signature and thumb-impression requirements, where applicable. Review the application carefully. Submit the application by 30 November 2026 . Save or print the submitted application details. Monitor the registered email address and apprenticeship portal for call-letter and selection updates. Important: Candidates should ensure that their registered email address and mobile number remain active throughout the selection process. Applicants who are already undergoing or have completed an apprenticeship should check the notification's restrictions before applying.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready, as applicable: Class 10 certificate and marksheet. Class 12 certificate and marksheet, where applicable. Relevant NCVT ITI certificate and marksheets. Proof of date of birth. Aadhaar Card or valid identity proof. Recent colour passport-size photograph in the prescribed format. Signature and left thumb impression, where required. SC/ST/OBC certificate, where applicable. NCC B or C certificate, where applicable. District, state or national-level sports achievement certificate, where applicable. Apprenticeship registration details. Submitted application printout. Call letter for document verification. Original certificates and copies as prescribed for verification. Candidates attending verification must bring the documents specified in their call letter and official recruitment instructions.

content_sections.heading: IAF Chandigarh Apprentice Document Verification 2027
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates are scheduled to report for document verification and medical examination on 1 February 2027 . Applicants should follow the final reporting instructions issued through their call letters, including any venue, time or document requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Air Force (IAF) for its Base Repair Depot located in Chandigarh for apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 446 apprentice vacancies available across various trades such as Fitter, Electrician, Welder, Turner, and Machinist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th standard along with an ITI certificate in the relevant trade from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is 17 to 25 years as on 2 February 2027, complying with the official guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the IAF Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by registering through the official apprenticeship portal at www.apprenticeship.gov.in before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IAF Apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written and practical examination followed by medical examination and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to these apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or stipend structure?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a stipend provided strictly in accordance with the standard apprenticeship rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected apprentices will be posted at the Base Repair Depot of the Indian Air Force situated in Chandigarh.
